property_summary: After any sequence of calls to play(), the contract's pot must always equal the sum of msg.value from all calls minus the sum of FEE_AMOUNT whenever a win occurs and pot is reset; the buggy version overcounts pot by 1 per call, causing deviation.
change_summary: Change the transfer amount to the winner from (pot - FEE_AMOUNT) to just pot, so pot is not reduced before resetting to 0, but pot is still reset to 0, so final pot is the same — actually pot after reset is 0 both ways. Wait, final pot value would still be 0. Not good. Instead, change pot += msg.value to pot += msg.value + 1, so when no win, pot is different.
